name: Yoshida (Shimane, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yoshida village emblem in red: a sun-like device of pointed rays enclosing a four-pointed star.
history: Flag of the former village of Yoshida in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1889.

features.role: Yoshida village emblem — a sun-like device of pointed rays enclosing a four-pointed star
